governance.note: Active levers all trace to measured inputs: CAMPD unit-level outage windows (campd-unit-outages-NYISO.csv, exogenous availability), EIA-860 cogen-flagged BTM CHP host steam pulled out of the LP (btm.parquet: CC_CHP 3.3-4.8 / CT_CHP 0-0.25 / ST_CHP 0-0.16 TWh by year), measured F923 per-plant monthly delivered gas with the measured EIA NG Weekly Transco Z6 NY monthly spot hub-basis overlay (zonal basis spreads), measured EIA-930 net-interchange schedule + priced import/export node, measured EIA-860 dual-fuel switching at the delivered oil price, measured interface TTC postings. No adder/haircut/sigmoid tuned to the price or volume residual; no unit pinned to its observed CEMS generation; no input rescaled so the model output lands on actuals.
governance.btm_basis_note: BTM-basis re-solve (byte-faithful: re-solved gmModel reproduces the committed keeper to <0.1%, e.g. 2023 CC_REGULAR 30.67->30.68, CC_CHP 15.58->15.59). Adding btm.parquet scores the CHP classes on the grid-delivered basis: 2024 CC_CHP clears (was -2.93 TWh). Residual CHP misses are model over-dispatch (2023/2025 CC_CHP +2.3/+2.9 TWh = some CC-CHP plants run above their measured EIA-923 grid output), NOT a benchmark artifact.
